positions.pos: The studio boat becomes a cross-section of a big tall ship, and its rooms are the pipeline. Stern to bow are the seven studio stages: Concept in the captain's cabin under the wheel where you steer, Systems Design in the chart room, Technical Setup in the carpenter's shop, Pre-Production in the model shop, Production in the workshop, Polish in the sail loft, and Release in the forecastle facing the live site. This stands unless you flip it.

It might even make sense to orient the boat in the direction of the pipeline". Still and plan: https://claude.ai/artifact/GM4aktqN5uvuu3bfhbmgzb

positions.pos: A strand's spirit lives in the room of its current stage and walks one room bow-ward when that stage passes. A finished strand steps out the forecastle door to the live-site island. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: ty-genre-mix and bw-spirit-is-strand: the spirit is the strand, so its place on the ship is its stage. https://claude.ai/artifact/GM4aktqN5uvuu3bfhbmgzb

positions.pos: A steer from the boat is the board's own save, sent to the same address (POST /api/board/saves), with no new save shape. That save already starts the board pull at once, which writes it to main. This stands unless you flip it.
positions.why: bw-talk-is-save; bars-engine src/app/api/board/saves/route.ts calls dispatchBoardPull() for record kinds, so a steer reaches the repo today. https://claude.ai/artifact/GM4aktqN5uvuu3bfhbmgzb

positions.pos: Once a steer lands on main, every surface updates from main: the boat and the bars-engine board read main on load (works now); the board pull starts the Board Send routine so the board read routes the steer to the thread that owns the strand and republishes the artifact board until it retires (to build: the pull does not fire the routine yet); and coding sessions on a computer pull main at start and list the steers since their last session (to build, a start-up hook). positions.pos: The boat guesses phone or computer from the screen and shows it as a badge you can tap to correct. On the phone: read, open cards, answer, steer, defer. On a computer signed in to Claude: also send a crew member to a spirit, which starts a cloud thread. Work that needs your Mac's own apps or files queues for a thread that drives your Mac and shows as waiting for your Mac. Nothing is greyed out. This stands unless you flip it.
